skills.name: graphql-architect
skills.description: Use when designing GraphQL schemas, implementing Apollo Federation, or building real-time subscriptions. Invoke for schema design, resolvers with DataLoader, query optimization, federation directives.
skills.applicability_reasoning: Repository evidence shows GraphQL schema-first generation with explicit federation support and command/config branches keyed by schema_type=federation.
skills.invocation_notes: Best used for federation-specific config, builder selection, or schema generation changes rather than generic PHP service wiring.
skills.expected_output_shape: Design notes, schema change plan, and affected bundle/config touchpoints.
common_failure_modes: Assuming a full GraphQL server implementation exists in-repo.
Ignoring that this repository mainly wires generation into a consumer app.

skills.name: php-async
skills.description: Use when building PHP applications with modern PHP 8.3+ features and async, Symfony frameworks. Invoke for strict typing, PSR standards.
skills.applicability_reasoning: Repository targets PHP 8.3+ and includes async amphp_v2/amphp_v3 executor configuration branches, but async behavior is configuration-level rather than widely implemented in local code.
skills.invocation_notes: Use narrowly for executor-related design or strict PHP 8.3 alignment; not for generic GraphQL schema planning.
skills.expected_output_shape: Executor/config guidance and Symfony wiring notes.
common_failure_modes: Over-designing async runtime flow beyond the evidence present in the bundle.
Ignoring that amphp support is mostly selected through config and builder aliases.

skills.name: php-graphql
skills.description: Use when working with PHP and GraphQL and Symfony framework bundle flexeble-graphql-bundle.
skills.applicability_reasoning: The supplied skill explicitly targets this bundle's PHP + GraphQL + Symfony context and aligns with the repository's core purpose and module layout.

skills.expected_output_shape: Bundle-aware implementation plan with touched files, config implications, and consumer validation notes.

skills.name: php-symfony
skills.description: Use when building PHP applications with modern PHP 8.3+ features, Symfony frameworks. Invoke for strict typing, PSR standards. PHPStan level 9 compliance guidance available.
skills.applicability_reasoning: Repository is a Symfony bundle with DI extension, console commands, and cache warmer integration, making Symfony service wiring and bundle architecture central.

skills.expected_output_shape: Symfony wiring plan with touched services, commands, tags, and validation approach.
common_failure_modes: Assuming full app kernel structure exists in-repo.
